sources: direct Codex tool-call evidence from W2

invariants.rule: Codex must not maintain a second MCP server registry for this repository.
invariants.enforcement: All configured-server truth comes from root .mcp.json; Codex reports may contain evidence snapshots only.

invariants.rule: A live MCP OS process is not proof that Codex can call the MCP.
invariants.enforcement: Reports must separate configured, process-visible, and callable states.

invariants.rule: CLI, plugin, web, or direct-DB fallbacks are degraded routes unless they expose the same MCP contract.
invariants.enforcement: Fallback messages must include the unavailable MCP and the substitute being used.

invariants.rule: Detached manual stdio MCP launches are not equivalent to host-attached MCP access.
invariants.enforcement: Codex may audit process health, but parity requires the Codex host to expose callable tools.

invariants.rule: This plan does not change credentials or environment variable values.
invariants.enforcement: W2 only records required env state and route decisions.

standard_failure_messages.raw_mcp_unavailable: DEGRADED_FALLBACK: <server_id> is configured in .mcp.json for Claude, but Codex has no callable MCP tool surface in this session; using <substitute> instead.
standard_failure_messages.process_only: BLOCKED: <server_id> has a visible MCP process, but Codex cannot call its tools; process presence is not MCP parity.
standard_failure_messages.closed_transport: BLOCKED: <server_id> tool namespace is exposed, but the transport is closed; restart or reattach through the MCP host before claiming parity.
standard_failure_messages.plugin_substitute: SUBSTITUTE_ROUTE: <server_id> is available through a Codex plugin or adjacent tool with different API shape; verify schema/tool-name differences before mutation.
standard_failure_messages.no_substitute: BLOCKED: <server_id> is unavailable in Codex and has no honest substitute for this operation.

routes.desired_claude_contract: Git/PR authority via git_status, git_add_or_commit, git_log_or_diff, pull_request_create.
routes.route_owner: Codex host for parity exposure; Codex agent for fallback disclosure.
routes.mutation_constraints: Follow Codex git safety rules; do not claim GitKraken authority.
routes.w2_decision: Require host-level GitKraken MCP exposure for parity. Native git is a degraded fallback only until the host route is callable.

routes.desired_claude_contract: ADG structural authority via adg_health first, SQLite canonical, Redis optional cache.
routes.route_owner: Codex host must expose and keep stdio transport attached.
routes.codex_route: mcp__adg_sqlite namespace when transport is open.
routes.mutation_constraints: Read-only structural queries; direct SQLite fallback must be labeled degraded.
routes.w2_decision: Treat current route as blocked until adg_health succeeds from Codex. Do not replace with detached manual launch.

routes.desired_claude_contract: External GitHub repository wiki/Q&A via read_wiki_structure, read_wiki_contents, ask_question.
routes.route_owner: Codex host for parity exposure; Codex agent for fallback disclosure.
routes.codex_route: GitHub plugin, Tavily/web, or official docs only as named substitutes.
routes.mutation_constraints: Read-only research substitute; cite actual sources used.
routes.w2_decision: Require host-level DeepWiki exposure for parity. Web/GitHub substitutes are not DeepWiki-backed.

routes.desired_claude_contract: Session recall and durable decision writeback via mem_recall_session_start, create_entities, add_observations, search_nodes.
routes.route_owner: Codex host must expose callable Memory MCP tools.
routes.codex_route: No accepted substitute for persistent memory compliance.
routes.mutation_constraints: Do not claim memory writeback or first-call compliance unless the Memory MCP is callable.
routes.w2_decision: Memory is parity-critical. Process-only visibility remains blocked.

routes.desired_claude_contract: Semantic search and vector stats via semantic_search, query_collection, vector_stats, list_collections.
routes.route_owner: Codex host for parity exposure; Codex agent for fallback disclosure.
routes.codex_route: rg lexical search, ADG structural search, or direct Chroma inspection only when fit for purpose.
routes.mutation_constraints: Do not represent lexical search as semantic search.
routes.w2_decision: Require host-level Vector DB exposure for semantic parity; otherwise use explicitly degraded substitutes.

routes.desired_claude_contract: Plans/Backlog access via Claude Notion MCP API-query-data-source, API-post-page, API-patch-page.
routes.route_owner: Codex Notion plugin for current route; Codex host for raw MCP parity if required later.
routes.mutation_constraints: Fetch schema before writes; use exact property names; Plans/Backlog only; do not write archived DBs.
routes.w2_decision: Accept plugin substitute for this plan because W1/W2 Notion registration and update succeeded. Record API-shape delta.

routes.desired_claude_contract: Versioned official library docs via resolve-library-id and get-library-docs.
routes.route_owner: Codex host for parity exposure; Codex agent for source disclosure.
routes.codex_route: Official docs/web search or domain-specific plugin docs; use only when source freshness/authority requirements are met.
routes.mutation_constraints: For technical answers, rely on primary official docs and cite source; do not claim Context7 use.
routes.w2_decision: Require host-level Context7 exposure for raw parity. Process-only context7 is not callable.

routes.desired_claude_contract: Browser automation via browser_navigate, browser_snapshot, browser_click, browser_fill_form, browser_take_screenshot.
routes.route_owner: Codex node_repl/Browser plugin for substitute; Codex host for raw Playwright MCP parity.
routes.codex_route: node_repl browser automation and Browser plugin skills.
routes.mutation_constraints: Label as substitute when raw browser_* MCP tools are absent; verify screenshots/interactions when frontend work requires it.
routes.w2_decision: Accept substitute route for Codex browser verification unless raw Claude Playwright MCP parity is explicitly required.

Add fixture-backed tests for blocked transport, process-only, plugin-substitute, and degraded-fallback states.
Optionally add a callable evidence adapter when Codex exposes more MCP tools.
